description: Convert the default greenfield example and legacy adoption walkthrough into complete natural-English references. The example must demonstrate the same Product Feature Coding Rules and Progress contracts that new English projects receive.
acceptance_criteria: The default greenfield example contains English Product Feature and Coding Rules natural-language content
The legacy walkthrough explains the complete adoption flow in natural English
Example Feature IDs detail files counts dependencies and JSON remain consistent
The example does not introduce a duplicated translated workflow source tree
